title: Human subthalamic nucleus LFP during a stop-signal task (STN delta; Szabo et al.; derivative, 250 Hz)
description: Intraoperative local field potential recordings from the subthalamic nucleus of 13 patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation surgery while performing a stop-signal reaction time task. This derivative release repackages the authors' filtered 250 Hz continuous LFP (0.5 Hz high-pass version) in BIDS iEEG format with annotations converted to events files. It supports study of delta-frequency activity in the human STN during action cancellation.
methods_description: Microelectrode LFP was recorded intraoperatively from the STN during a stop-signal task. The authors' 250 Hz EEGLAB files (high-pass filtered and notch-filtered or cleaned) were converted to BrainVision float32 µV with unchanged values, and EEGLAB annotations were written to events.tsv.
